draft.subject: Quick help getting your first project set up
draft.body:
Hi Maya,

Sorry we missed each other for last week's call — easy to reschedule whenever suits you.

If it's useful, the fastest way to see what Wrenfield is for is one project with a few real tasks; projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and you're on the Team plan, so a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I'm happy to walk through that first project with you.

Best,
Chidi
